description: The figure presents two line plots comparing training performance across two distinct datasets: “Easy Training Set” (top) and “Hard Training Set” (bottom), both illustrating how training rewards evolve over steps for different Llama-based methods. In both plots, the x-axis is labeled “Steps,” spans from 0 to 500 with linear scaling and major tick marks at intervals of 100, while the y-axis, labeled “Training Rewards,” ranges from 0.0 to 0.4 in the top plot and from 0.0 to 0.2 in the bottom plot, also linearly scaled with tick intervals of 0.1. In the top plot, two lines are shown: “Llama-LUFFY-Easy” (red solid line with shaded confidence interval) starts near 0.0, rises steeply to ~0.2 by step 100, and gradually climbs to ~0.4 by step 500; the other line (teal solid, labeled “Llama-On-Policy-Easy” in the legend but not explicitly named in the plot) follows a similar trajectory but with slightly lower and noisier rewards, peaking around 0.35–0.38. In the bottom plot, “Llama-LUFFY-Hard” (red solid with shaded region) begins near 0.0, rises to ~0.1 by step 100, and continues fluctuating upward to ~0.2 by step 500, while “Llama-On-Policy-Hard” (teal solid) starts near 0.0, briefly peaks around 0.05 at step 50, then declines to near 0.0 by step 150 and remains flat thereafter. Both plots include gridlines and use shaded regions to indicate uncertainty or variance around the mean reward trajectories.
